problem: Out of all the subjects that you can study at the University of Cambridge, which ones saw an increase in the percentage of acceptances of students from Maintained schools between the 2019 and 2021 undergraduate admissions cycles and then also between the 2021 and 2023 undergraduate admissions cycles. Consider Home applicants only.
answer: "Anglo-Saxon, Norse, & Celtic", Archaeology, Economics, History, History of Art, Land Economy, "Theology, Religion & Philosophy of Religion", Computer Science, Natural Sciences
